title: Link commencement speech excerpt to official Stanford source
description: Add a link in the example page attribution pointing to the official Stanford News transcript of Steve Jobs's 2005 Commencement Address.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Linked commencement speech excerpt to the official Stanford News transcript (https://news.stanford.edu/2005/06/14/jobs-061505/) in the example byline and footer attribution. Both links are marked with data-auritus-ignore so spoken TTS text is unaffected. Verified with behave, pytest, and site build.
